## Maintainer ruling recorded — A2 · B1 · C3: the key family stays as #14412 ruled; the gate stops reporting a written inline map as `unauthored`; no node-path key scheme

Director seat, summon #11, session `session_01ShyhexkB2d1AeRZ85tgAAe`, 2026-09-03.

Provenance (who / verbatim / where): maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat, 2026-09-03, replying to decision batch #18 in which this card was item 3, presented as the three questions the cli seat's measurement derived (5519940610 / 5519964231 / 5520017846) rather than the card's original A/B/C, with the recommendation A2 · B1 · C3. Verbatim reply: 「同意」.

**Ruled, per question:**

- **Q1 — A2.** `content` and `body` do not join `PAGE_COMPONENT_COPY_KEYS`. The #14412 ruling of 2026-09-02 stands: the inline `I18nLabel` map is the localisation route for `element:text.content`; one external application's two `untranslatable` ledger rows are not pull enough to reverse a ruling one day old.
- **Q2 — B1.** `check:i18n-coverage` / the extractor stop recording a fully-written inline map under the same diagnostic as a key the author never wrote: a map present at an `I18nLabel`-typed prop is recorded as **authored, with its locales counted as covered and absent locales as gaps** — without extracting it, without a bundle row, without a new key family. The one-diagnostic-for-two-opposite-facts reading (`inlineText()` → `undefined` → `pushOptional` files it as unauthored) is the defect; it goes.
- **Q3 — C3.** No node-path key scheme is built. The exclusion — inline maps are outside extraction and the bundle, by design — is written where an author reads it (`i18n.zod.ts` and the extractor's header). Recorded direction if extraction of inline maps is ever wanted: **identity first** (C2 — `component.id` / `section.name` / `tabs item.value` made mandatory and gate-enforced, then the existing `pages.PAGE.components.ID.KEY` family reused); ⛔ never array-index keys (C1), which turn a sibling reorder into a silent, all-green translation swap.

Execution: `domain:cli` lane, S — B1 plus the C3 prose; changeset level by measurement (a CLI diagnostic changes). ⛔ No key family, no extraction, no `packages/spec` schema change. Related, not folded: #14817 (the three platform record pages are in no extract config — bare, for triage's first grading) and #14816 (the stale "31" in `i18n.zod.ts`).

State transition, same stroke: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`. Ledger: director seat post #12708, summon #11.

⚠️ This seat's reading, ⛔ not a ruling; the dev re-declares from the diff. A **gate stopping a false report** changes no published contract face.

## The ruling — settled, ⛔ not reopenable

Maintainer, director summon #11, recorded at `5522885154`: **A2 · B1 · C3** — the key family stays as **#14412** ruled; **the gate stops reporting a written inline map as `unauthored`**; ⛔ **no node-path key scheme**.

That third clause is a refusal, and it is the one a round is most likely to drift into: the obvious way to make the gate see an inline map is to invent a key derived from the node's path. ⛔ **Ruled out by name.**

## Surface

`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` · `packages/cli/src/commands/i18n/check.ts` · `packages/cli/src/commands/lint.ts` (the extractor and the coverage gate — the dev confirms the real set).

## ⚠️ In-flight check, narrowed after a broad one misled

A lane-wide regex over filenames matching `i18n` flagged **two** PRs (#15888, #15334). Read **per file**, **neither touches any of the three declared files** — #15888 is `spec/contracts/i18n-service.ts` + a rest test + docs; #15334 is changesets. ⇒ **free**. *A regex scoped to a lane is not a reading about a file* — this is the third false hold it produced today.
